materials.content: Repair the transit stop lookup cache: a fresh online-mode query mounted and unmounted entirely offline later calls its signal-consuming query function with a live signal after reconnect. This occurs independently of refetchOnReconnect. Preserve supported query behavior, interfaces, dependencies and build/test configuration. Change product source only.

# Transit stop lookup

A shared per-key query cache provides subscribe(key,options) -> unique observer
handle, unsubscribe(handle), online(boolean), focus(boolean), snapshot(key),
and dispose() of observer scopes. Queries retain status (pending/success/error),
fetchStatus (idle/fetching/paused), and data. queryFn receives a lazy signal
accessor. Each actual access records consumption; each fetch owns its controller
and completion. Completion is asynchronous; initial online entry is synchronous,
paused continuation resumes on a Promise turn. First start uses network mode;
continuation also needs focus. 'always' can run offline; 'offlineFirst' allows
first offline entry but retry can pause. Retries use explicit scheduler handles.
Multiple observers share one fetch. Unconsumed active work can finish into cache
after its view departs; consumed work is physically abortable. Cancellation
reverts previous query data/status and settles the originating attempt. Late
fulfillment cannot become a new attempt's data. Unknown unsubscribe is inert.
The component owns observer scope; the cache remains outside individual views.
Dependency versions and build/test configuration are outside the repair scope.

Embedding API: bind registers a native callable; Environment.call
provides newAttempt(key,number), abort(key,number), request(key,number, lazy-read
token, completion token), defer(callback token), schedule(callback token,delay).
The request host calls queryFn with an actual AbortSignal property. Reading it
invokes the native consumption closure synchronously; Promise settlement later
invokes the native completion with {ok,value}. All observer, retry, cancellation,
state and cache logic executes in the target language. No native JS Promise or
DOM claim is made. Native object identity binds query and attempt generations;
wire handles only identify injected callbacks. 
Module cache and EventTarget subscription handles; actual Node16 promises

修复离线期间创建并移除的全新 online 模式查询：重新联网后，不应以仍有效的 signal 调用会读取该 signal 的 queryFn；该现象与 refetchOnReconnect 无关。保留每个 key 的共享缓存和独立观察者句柄。首次启动按 networkMode 判断；暂停的工作在 Promise 后续轮次恢复，并受当前连接与焦点条件约束。实际读取 signal 时同步记录消费；取消请求与尝试结算分别处理。无观察者时，未消费的活动工作可以继续写入缓存；已消费的工作可以中止，取消时恢复先前状态并结算原尝试。晚到的完成结果不得写成新尝试的数据。仅改产品源码，保留接口、依赖及构建/测试配置。

materials.content: {"report":"Updated src/session.js: signal consumption is now tracked per attempt, and an unobserved paused attempt that never started is cancelled/settled so reconnect cannot invoke its queryFn. Unconsumed started work still completes into cache; consumed work still aborts and restores prior state. Verified with targeted lifecycle assertions and /runtime/node syntax check. No full test suite is present."}
{"report":"已修复 src/session.js：将 signal 消费状态绑定到具体尝试；最后一个观察者移除时，尚未启动且 paused 的尝试会被结算/回滚，因此重连不会调用其 queryFn。已验证离线挂载-移除-重连、已消费取消与晚到结果隔离、未消费已启动请求继续写缓存。未覆盖外部测试套件（仓库未提供测试脚本）。"}

The current task forbids a live signal at invocation for the fresh offline-departure situation. The original training check accepts zero calls or calls with an already-aborted signal; this does not establish a mandatory zero-entry implementation. All existing cached/active work and state/observer policies remain independently required.

evidence.statement: Cancellation settles the attempt, restores previous state and aborts its resource; active identity gates completion.
evidence.author: execution_agent_source_review

evidence.statement: A new query record has a consumption flag; creating another attempt does not directly reset that query flag. Actual invocation resets it.
evidence.author: execution_agent_source_review

evidence.statement: Unconsumed active shared work may finish after view departure; consumed work is abortable; canceled late fulfillment must not become new-attempt data.
evidence.author: execution_agent_source_review

anchors.quote:
Multiple observers share one fetch. Unconsumed active work can finish into cache
after its view departs; consumed work is physically abortable. Cancellation
reverts previous query data/status and settles the originating attempt. Late
fulfillment cannot become a new attempt's data. Unknown unsubscribe is inert.
The component owns observer scope; the cache remains outside individual views.

evidence.statement: Initial entry and paused continuation differ in timing and eligibility; actual lazy reads record consumption.
evidence.author: execution_agent_source_review

anchors.quote:
fetchStatus (idle/fetching/paused), and data. queryFn receives a lazy signal
accessor. Each actual access records consumption; each fetch owns its controller
and completion. Completion is asynchronous; initial online entry is synchronous,
paused continuation resumes on a Promise turn. First start uses network mode;
continuation also needs focus. 'always' can run offline; 'offlineFirst' allows
first offline entry but retry can pause. Retries use explicit scheduler handles.
